title.ko: 언어와 정체성: a sense of belonging · code-switching · be fluent in · mother tongue · heritage
title.en: language and identity: a sense of belonging, code-switching, heritage, mother tongue

explain.ko: 언어와 정체성에 관한 글은 언어를 단순한 소통 도구가 아니라 소속감, 문화, 권력과 연결해 논의합니다. 정체성은 a sense of belonging, heritage, mother tongue으로, 언어 접촉은 code-switching, bilingualism, assimilation으로, 위기는 endangered language, language loss로 표현합니다. 논증에서는 양면(while, whereas)과 헤징(tend to, may)으로 균형을 유지하고, 사례와 증거를 함께 제시합니다.
explain.en: Writing on language and identity treats language as more than communication, linking it to belonging, culture and power. Identity uses a sense of belonging, heritage, mother tongue; contact uses code-switching, bilingualism, assimilation; threat uses endangered language, language loss. In argument, keep balance with contrast (while, whereas) and hedging (tend to, may), supported by examples and evidence.

items.passage:
COLUMN
Accents and prejudice
We tend to guess a person's origin and class from their accent. But accent has nothing to do with ability. Prejudice against accents is a form of linguistic discrimination, and reducing it requires becoming familiar with varied speech.

prompt.ko: 언어와 정체성의 관계를 주장·이유·예·결론 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences on language and identity: claim, reason, example, conclusion.

task.model: Language is more than a tool of communication; it is central to identity. This is because the mother tongue gives people a sense of belonging. Immigrants who assimilate to a new culture yet try to keep their mother tongue are an example. So preserving minority languages means safeguarding cultural heritage.

model_trans.ko: 언어는 단순한 소통 도구 이상으로 정체성의 핵심입니다. 모국어는 사람에게 소속감을 주기 때문입니다. 이민자들이 새 문화에 동화되면서도 모국어를 지키려는 것이 그 예입니다. 따라서 소수 언어를 보존하는 것은 문화 유산을 지키는 일입니다.
model_trans.en: Language is more than a tool of communication; it is central to identity. This is because the mother tongue gives people a sense of belonging. Immigrants who assimilate to a new culture yet try to keep their mother tongue are an example. So preserving minority languages means safeguarding cultural heritage.
